spans.s: हहलं A kind of deadly poison.

हहा m. A kind of Gandharva;
cf. हाहा.

हाहा m. N. of a Gandharva.
--ind. An exclamation denoting
pain, grief or surprise, (it is
simply हा repeated for the sake of
emphasis; see हा).
--Comp.
--कारः {1}
a grief, lamentation, loud wailing.
[]
{2} the din or uproar of battle.
--रवः
the cry हाहा.
